title: OSF UI Settings Schema
description: Schema for settings/<modId>.json files. Bridge protocol 2.0.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by the OSF UI runtime.

id.description: Opaque mod id. Dots have no special meaning. Must be a non-empty Windows filename and URL-path component of at most 64 UTF-8 bytes and equal the filename stem; osfui is reserved for the platform.

title.description: English card header shown in Mod Settings. Defaults to id. Translation catalogs override it at settings.title; authors do not write localization keys.

description.description: Optional English one-line blurb. Translation catalogs override it at settings.description.

version.description: Optional schema version (default 0). New mods should declare "version": 1.

targetVersion.description: The OSF UI release version this schema was authored against (e.g. "2.0.0") - the same advisory field as a view manifest's. A target NEWER than the running OSF UI release badges 'needs update' in Mod Settings. A target BELOW 2.0 has no helper-shape effect because a settings schema executes nothing. Declare the release that first shipped whatever you rely on (tabbed `pages`, `onPress`, ...) so an older OSF UI release tells the player to update instead of silently degrading — an unrecognized base type renders read-only at the schema default, and an unrecognized `pages` list collapses into the plain group column.

accent.description: Optional per-mod accent colour (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa). Tints the mod's detail pane.

icon.description: Optional badge image, shown in the Mod Settings rail and inside the Home launcher cards of this mod's views, in place of the title-initials monogram. A path inside the mod's own views namespace folder (views/<modId>/...), with the same sandbox rules as image rows' `src`: no '..', no absolute paths, no URL schemes, no percent-encoding. SVG or PNG; drawn at ~30-52px square (`object-fit: contain`).

presets.description: Author-shipped value sets applied as a batch of settings. Partial value maps are fine - unlisted keys are left untouched.

id.description: Optional stable localization identity. Without it, the preset array index is used.

label.description: English preset button label; localized at presets.<id>.label.

description.description: Optional English tooltip; localized at presets.<id>.description.

values.description: key -> value map applied when the preset is chosen. Each value is validated/clamped natively like any settings.set.

inputContexts.description: Authored hotkey contexts local to this mod. These are distinct from Starfield's live engine input contexts. Referenced by key settings through inputContext. The implicit id gameplay is reserved and cannot be redefined.

pages.description: Optional tabs for the mod's page in Mod Settings. Groups opt in via their `page` field; groups naming no (or an unknown) page collect on an implicit General tab painted first, and an unreferenced page renders no tab. Tabs engage only when they split content across at least two non-empty pages. Display-only annotation on the flat groups list - older OSF UI releases that predate pages render the plain group column unchanged.

id.description: Page id referenced by groups' `page`. Also the localization identity: pages.<id>.label.

label.description: English tab label; defaults to id. Localized at pages.<id>.label.

id.description: Optional stable localization identity. Without it, the group array index is used.

label.description: Optional English section heading; localized at groups.<id>.label.

page.description: Id of a top-level pages[] entry this group renders under. Missing or unknown ids land the group on the implicit General tab.

visibleWhen.description: Show the whole group only when this condition holds (display-only).

id.description: Context id local to this mod. gameplay is reserved for the implicit default context.

label.description: English context label, such as During OSF scenes. Defaults to id; localized at inputContexts.<id>.label.

blocksGameplay.description: Author assertion that Starfield gameplay bindings cannot fire while this context is active. Game-binding collisions are shown as expected shares; mod-to-mod collisions are still evaluated by gameplayModes overlap.

gameplayModes.description: Stable semantic gameplay modes in which keys using this context dispatch. Missing, invalid, or empty arrays preserve legacy unscoped non-menu dispatch.

script.description: Papyrus script name (without .pex) containing the GLOBAL callback. Namespace separators are allowed.

function.description: GLOBAL function called as Function name(string asModId, string asKey) Global.

item.description: A row in a group: a value-bearing setting, or a static/action item (note/image/action).

key.description: Stable identifier, unique within the mod. Used as the persisted key, in the settings.set / settings.reset requests, and as the `key` field of the settings.changed and ui.hotkey events. Renaming it orphans the stored value — use `aliases` instead.

aliases.description: Former keys this setting was persisted under. On load, if the current `key` is absent from the values file, the first listed alias whose stored value still validates is adopted, then rewritten under `key` (the old alias key drops). Declarative one-way rename; no version arithmetic. The current key always wins over an alias.

label.description: Control label. Defaults to key; localized at settings.<key>.label.

hint.description: Optional helper text; localized at settings.<key>.hint.

type.description: Control + validation kind. bool = toggle; int/float clamp to [min,max]; enum must be one of options; string truncates to maxLength; key = a rebindable physical key name captured by a press; flags = multi-select over options (value = array of option strings, filtered/deduped natively). Colour is NOT a type: use type:"string" + widget:"color". A schema using a newer base type should declare the matching schema-level targetVersion so older OSF UI releases show the 'needs update' badge.

default.description: Initial value, used until the user changes it and on reset. Should match the type. The 'modified' indicator compares the live value against this.

maxLength.description: string max length (UI hint; native ceiling is 256 today).

allowUnbound.description: key type only: permit "" as the deliberate unbound state (default "" is then legal). Unbound keys never dispatch hotkeys and never appear in conflicts; the settings UI renders an unbind x next to the capture button.

inputContext.description: key type only: local inputContexts id. Missing, invalid, or unknown ids fall back to implicit gameplay.

onPress.description: key type only: immutable schema-owned GLOBAL Papyrus callback queued after the normal hotkey delivery channels. Never persisted in the user values file.

options.description: Allowed values for an enum or flags setting. An enum's stored value is always one of these strings; a flags value is an array drawn from them (canonicalized to this order).

optionLabels.description: Optional labels parallel to options[]. Localized by stable stored value at settings.<key>.options.<option>; the stored value is never translated.

widget.description: Display hint. int/float: slider (default) | stepper. enum: dropdown (default) | segmented. string: text (default) | textarea | color (swatch + #hex, stored as a hex string).

format.description: int/float display formatting. Store the raw value; show a friendly string. e.g. store 0.0-1.0 with {scale:100,suffix:"%",decimals:0} shows "85%".

prefix.description: English display prefix; localized at settings.<key>.format.prefix.

suffix.description: English display suffix; localized at settings.<key>.format.suffix.

scale.description: Multiply the stored value by this for display (default 1).

decimals.description: Fixed decimal places in the display string (0-20; clamped by the renderer).

requires.description: Marks that a change to this setting takes effect only after a game restart / overlay reload / new game. Shows a badge and aggregates into a banner.

visibleWhen.description: Show this row only when the condition holds (display-only; a hidden setting is still writable and still validated natively).

enabledWhen.description: Enable this control only when the condition holds (display-only).

id.description: Optional stable localization identity; without it, the item index is used.

text.description: static rich text. Micro-markdown only: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, and \n line breaks. No HTML or links. Localized at notes.<id>.text.

id.description: Optional stable localization identity; without it, the item index is used.

src.description: Image path relative to the mod namespace folder views/<modId>/. No '..', absolute paths, or URL schemes.

caption.description: Optional English caption; localized at images.<id>.caption.

height.description: Optional fixed display height in px.

label.description: English button label; localized at actions.<key>.label.

hint.description: Optional English helper text; localized at actions.<key>.hint.

command.description: Compatibility field containing the bridge REQUEST endpoint name fired on click. It MUST be namespaced with the mod id ("<id>.something"); Mod Settings refuses any other name, and refuses a leading segment from a framework namespace (ui, menu, hud, settings, views, game, runtime) even if a schema claims one as its id. Register it in your SFSE plugin with RegisterRequest, NOT RegisterSend — a button needs an outcome, and that is exactly what separates the two endpoint kinds; registering the name as a send instead makes the card's request come back `wrong-endpoint-kind` and the button report a failure. Settle it exactly once: Respond with an object — an optional string `message` is shown as a toast, `{}` is a silent success — or Reject with a code and sentence, which is shown as an error toast. The button sends { mod, key } and waits 5s; a handler that never settles rejects with `timeout`, which Mod Settings renders as 'No response from <mod>'. Papyrus cannot serve an action row: it registers listeners for the fixed papyrus.send/papyrus.request endpoints, not for named endpoints of its own.

confirm.description: English inline confirmation message; localized at actions.<key>.confirm.

condition.description: Display-only predicate over sibling setting values in the same mod. A leaf references one key with exactly one operator; combinators nest. A reference to an unknown key evaluates false.

in.description: key's value is one of these

truthy.description: true: key's value is truthy; false: falsy
